claims: Georgia is a Southeastern U.S. state.
Georgia has a 2025 estimated population of over 11.3 million.
Atlanta is the capital of Georgia.
Georgia has a cost of living 8% lower than the national average.
Georgia is one of the original 13 colonies.
Georgia's major cities include Savannah, Augusta, Columbus, and Macon.
Georgia ranks as the eighth-most populous state.
Georgia's housing costs are 20% below the national average.
The Masters golf tournament is in Augusta.
The country of Georgia is located in the Caucasus region.
